title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Free-Boundary Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.02084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study free-boundary problems within a physics-informed framework using Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) approximations. The proposed approach incorporates obstacle constraints, partial differential equation (PDE) inequalities, complementarity conditions, and boundary conditions through residual-based loss functions. We consider a linear elliptic obstacle problem, a nonlinear $p$-Laplacian obstacle problem, and a time-dependent one-phase Stefan problem. The proposed KAN solver is compared with physics-informed neural network (PINN) and residual-network baselines. Numerical experiments show that KANs achieve low relative $L^2$ and $L^\infty$ errors while accurately resolving contact regions and moving interfaces. The results indicate that KAN representations provide an effective alternative for solving free-boundary PDEs.

translated_title: 用于自由边界偏微分方程的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
translated_abstract: 我们在物理信息框架下使用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）近似来研究自由边界问题。所提出的方法通过基于残差的损失函数纳入了障碍约束、偏微分方程（PDE）不等式、互补条件和边界条件。我们考虑了线性椭圆障碍问题、非线性p-拉普拉斯障碍问题以及与时间相关的单相Stefan问题。将所提出的KAN求解器与物理信息神经网络（PINN）和残差网络基线进行了比较。数值实验表明，KAN在实现较低的相对L²和L^∞误差的同时，能够准确解析接触区域和移动界面。结果表明，KAN表示为求解自由边界偏微分方程提供了一种有效的替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出将Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）与物理信息框架结合，通过基于残差的损失函数处理障碍约束、PDE不等式、互补条件和边界条件，在求解椭圆障碍问题、p-拉普拉斯障碍问题和单相Stefan问题等自由边界偏微分方程时，相比PINN等基线方法取得了更低的误差并能准确捕捉接触区域和移动界面。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) with a physics-informed framework, incorporating obstacle constraints, PDE inequalities, complementarity conditions, and boundary conditions through residual-based losses, demonstrating lower relative L² and L^∞ errors than PINN baselines while accurately resolving contact regions and moving interfaces in free-boundary PDEs such as obstacle problems and the one-phase Stefan problem.
